## Practice questions

Seven to ten questions covering everything in Analytics & Measurement, each with an answer key
that explains why the right answer is right.

:::quiz
Q. What does a UTM parameter do?
+ Tags a link so analytics can report which campaign the visit came from
- Speeds up the page it points to
- Stops other sites linking to you
= UTMs are how a click is attributed to a source, a medium and a campaign.
:::

## Where to look if you got one wrong

A pointer back to the lesson each question came from.

## The brief

A monthly performance report for Petal & Pine. What is being asked for, and the constraints it has to work inside.

## What to submit

The file, the format and anything that must be shown alongside it.

:::template Submission cover sheet
Name:
Brand:
Module: Analytics & Measurement
Deliverable:
Time spent:
What I would do differently with more budget:
:::

## Marking rubric

Marked out of 100. The bands below are placeholders until the assignment is written.

- Research and understanding of the audience — 20 marks
- Correct use of the method taught in this module — 30 marks
- Quality and realism of the deliverable — 30 marks
- Clarity of presentation and reasoning — 20 marks

A pass is 50. Anything that invents data about a real company scores zero on realism.
